#: The runtime's GPU (run.py --cases gpu-answers,gpu-other-adapter --script scripts/gfx_all_apis.json --expect expect/gpu.json --allow-skip "gpu-.*"): the stand-in's D3D requirements name the last DXGI adapter, and GetDXGIOutputInfo (IVRSystem and IVRExtendedDisplay), GetD3D9AdapterIndex and GetOutputDevice for D3D11 and D3D12 answer it; GetOutputDevice for Vulkan answers the physical device the runtime wants for the game's instance. A game on another adapter has its session tried, which the stand-in refuses (as Monado does), and then gets TextureIsOnWrongDevice from Submit (skipped with one adapter, and the Vulkan record without a Vulkan driver).
